install.title: Install Nels
install.body: Add Nels to your device for a faster, full-screen, app-like experience.
install.iosBody: Tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen.”

auth.heroTitle: Nels thinks about your money so you don't have to.
auth.heroSubtitle: Sign in with a passkey — no password, no codes.
auth.toggleToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign In
auth.toggleToRegister: New to Nels? Register a new account
auth.regSuccessBody: Your account is registered. Here is your session token — copy this if you need to authenticate on other devices or via the API.
auth.securityHeading: Built on trust. Secured by standards.
auth.securityPasswordless: Passwordless sign-in with a passkey — the same standard banks and Big Tech use. No password, no codes, nothing to steal.
auth.securityData: Your financial data is encrypted in transit and never sold.
auth.securityBank: Bank connections are read-only, through regulated providers like Stripe. Nels never sees your bank login.
auth.passkeyInfo: Nels uses passkeys. No password, no codes! Register once and your device's built-in security (fingerprint, face, or PIN) signs you in from then on.
auth.recoveryCodesBody: If you ever lose access to every device with a passkey for Nels, one of these one-time codes lets you back in. Store them somewhere safe — they're shown only once.
auth.recoveryDesc: Enter your email and one of your recovery codes to enroll a new passkey on this device.
auth.useRecoveryCode: Lost your passkey? Use a recovery code

aiProvider.title: AI provider
aiProvider.intro: Choose where Nels sends your chat requests. The request includes the budget details needed to answer.
aiProvider.keyHint: Stored encrypted. Nels never shows it again — only its last 4 characters.
aiProvider.statusOffline: AI is not configured on this server; basic offline replies only.
aiProvider.statusByoOk: Using your {provider} key ending in {last4}, checked {date}.
aiProvider.statusByoRejected: {provider} rejected your key ending in {last4}. Replace it to keep chatting.
aiProvider.statusByoUnreadable: Your saved key can't be read. Please enter it again.
aiProvider.embeddingsOff: {provider} can't create search vectors compatible with Nels, so smart transaction search and conversation memory are off while you use it.
aiProvider.dataUseNels: Your requests go to Google's Gemini API under Nels's paid account. Google's API terms govern how Google handles them.
aiProvider.dataUseOwn: Your requests go to {provider} under your own account and your own agreement with {provider}.
aiProvider.dataUsePassesThrough: Either way, Nels's server builds each request from your data, so Nels still processes it. Your own key changes who receives it, not whether Nels sees it.
aiProvider.dataUseShared: Chats about budgets shared with you use your provider choice.
aiProvider.chatErrorQuota: Your AI key is out of quota or rate-limited.
